lemma hasDetPlusMinusOne_iff_abs_det [LinearOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] :
    HasDetPlusMinusOne Γ ↔ ∀ {g}, g ∈ Γ → |g.det.val| = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro h g hg
    exact h.abs_det hg
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    intro g hg
    have habs : |g.det.val| = 1 := h hg
    -- turn `|x| = 1` into `x = 1 ∨ x = -1`
    rcases abs_eq (a := g.det.val) (b := 1) (by exact zero_le_one) |>.1 habs with hdet | hdet
    · -- `g.det.val = 1`
      left
      -- `Units.val_inj` turns equality of `val`s into equality of units
      exact Units.val_inj.1 (by simpa using hdet)
    · -- `g.det.val = -1`
      right
      exact Units.val_inj.1 (by simpa using hdet)
